note: The link schemes, read by both halves: the server's submission check and the
interface's renderer. Each half compares its own list with this file, so a
scheme accepted at submission and dropped on screen fails a test on the side
'link' is what a link in submitted text may use. 'address' is what a link
leaving the deployment may name: a document's address, and a rendered link
once attachment and issue references are rewritten into paths.
